0022600042.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (8-3, 6th in the West) visit the LA Clippers (2-8, 13th in the West) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup, the Thunder's 13th game of the season, as Oklahoma City is coming off a loss while the Clippers have lost eight of their last ten. The Thunder will be without Ajay Mitchell (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), while Cam Christie (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, and the Thunder lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 108-101 win in Oklahoma City on October 25, following a 3-0 sweep in 2025-26.
